# Pritom Kumar Mondal

Pritom Kumar Mondal is a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET), AI QA engineer, and Web3 test automation specialist.

- Web3 and blockchain quality assurance
- Python, Pytest, Selenium, Appium, and API test automation

- CI/CD quality systems and GitHub Actions
- Machine learning, software-defined networking, and research engineering
